summary.overview: Earth's 24-hour axial rotation from west to east causes the day and night cycle and apparent solar movement across the sky. Seasons' Journals document annual climate shifts across 5 themes: Plants, Animals, Air/Heat, Water Bodies, and Human Activities. Biological organisms respond to seasonal cues: the Koel (cuckoo) bird singing in Odisha acts as a bio-indicator telling farmers to sow monsoon seeds. Sundial shadow lengths vary from morning to noon.
